Project Home Key · San Diego, CA

Request help

Tell us what you need. Check any boxes that fit, write a few words about what is going on, and send — no account needed.

We are in Phase 0 — please read this first

We cannot provide direct housing or money yet. We review every inquiry and connect you to verified free resources that exist today. We review inquiries as quickly as we can, but we cannot promise a reply by a certain day.

What do you need help with? (check all that fit)

Your privacy: we ask for as little as possible. What you share here is only seen by the Project Home Key team, only used to review your request and reply if you asked us to — never sold, never shared.

Need help right now? Do not wait for us — dial 2-1-1 (free, 24 hours a day, English and Spanish) or browse the free help finder.

Everyone has a place to call home.
